comments.quote: 過來跑莫干山跑山賽，住在這個民宿，離起點15分鐘車程，房間很大，設施很新，還有一個超大泳池，天氣熱適合家庭入住，老闆人也非常的不錯，早飯也很好，推薦入住

comments.quoteEn: I came for the Moganshan trail race and stayed here, fifteen minutes drive from the start. Big room, new fittings, and an enormous pool, so it suits a family in hot weather. The owner is a good sort and breakfast was good. Recommended.
